entries.topic: I have nothing but happy memories of my parents. But I do get sad, knowing they live only in memory.
Have you ever been to my home in Tellus? It's a wealthy county and has an easiness to it.
I go on long rides every now and then. Would you like to come along sometime?
How do you take care of your feathers? They're so pretty
I'm trying to live up to the name of "Silver Maiden," and with Bucephalus, I'm sure that I will!
It must be scary to live out in the wild. Please call for me if you're ever going somewhere dangerous!
I'm confident in my abilities in battle. I should show you what I can do sometime!
I heard someone talking about me behind my back earlier. What should I do about that?
It feels great to soar in the sky, doesn't it? How high can you fly?
Would you like to meet Bucephalus? It'd be fun if you two were friends!
Words like "repent," "regret," and "reform" are all strange to me. But I suspect you do all of that.
Have you read the War Chronicle of Hasdrubal? I assure you, its scenes will thrill you to the core!
I was a fine specimen of a man in my youth. No matter where I went, people sang my praises!
No matter how many times you fail, your dream doesn't die until you do. Good advice, right?
I am brilliant, amazing, dashing, and more! And I'm a perfect general! You agree fully, correct?
I got a secret under my eye patch that relates to my past. I won't tell you about it though. HA!
It's only a matter of time before you realize that I was the best leader of this whole era!
I despise a bland meal. I want a life of luxury. You must want that too, yes?
Rarities fetch a high price, which is why I like them. Not that you'd know about such things.
Is it obvious that I take painstaking care of my beard?
Future generations will surely surpass us. Hm! I look forward to it.
Would a wild and unfettered bird consider it cruel to be captured as a gift for my queen?
Surely I do not lecture as much as they say. Do I?
Do you believe a bright future awaits Saramis?
Looking at you give me a sense of déjà vu. Why do you suppose that is?
One's duties must take precedence over all else. Even if the end result is divorce.
As they listened, the lovely maidens were enchanted by the bard's voice.
I would say I remain sharp despite my age. Wouldn't you agree?
Off late, I find myself mired in dismal thoughts...
Let's say an enemy attacked while your charge stood behind you. What would you do?
You're tenacious. If you were human, I'd want to train you as a knight.
I know well the sound of the vihuela. I'm sure it would go beautifully with birdsong.
Most my age have had romantic relationships — I've only had loyalty to my lord. But that's fine, right?
When we were in hiding, I did all the cooking. Would you like me to make you something?
Any scar you get in your lord's service is a badge of honor. Mine is handsome, don't you think?
When I lived in Cydonia, I tutored youths in combat. Would you like me to teach you some martial arts?
The older I get, the more I find to grumble about. Perhaps I should work on that.
Milady's heart is consumed with a desire for revenge. What I would do to free her from it...
It's strange to see a bird with such conviction in its eyes.
It's neat how quick birds can move. You look like you could dodge any attack!
Today's a perfect day for fishing! You wanna come along with me sometime?
I can't stand cowardice. But I guess maybe that's better than getting used to it.
Do you think I'll ever be better with a spear than my dad?
I hear pretty birdsong sometimes. Is that you?
I wonder what the world looks like through your eyes.
How do you become an adult, anyway? It seems like everyone has to overcome a challenge to do it.
Sometimes, it's like people can guess what's on my mind. Am I that easy to read?
It's nice to unwind a little sometimes, huh?
I bet it'd be fun to play hide-and-seek with you!
I keep hearing about people getting married… Where is my ideal partner? I've been searching
I have a terrible scar that's hidden by my outfit. It's proof that I fight bravely. Impressive, yes?
I can tell if a bird's singing voice is truly beautiful or not. Is your song of sterling quality?
Caring for one's personal appearance is crucial. Are you taking good care of yourself?
My pockets are getting emptier, and so is my stomach. Maybe I'll just eat some bird food here...
If you value top quality, you develop an eye for it. And I am a sterling knight, you know.
I've traveled for years, so I learned how to amuse myself. Care to learn how to while away the time?
Always conduct yourself well, or it reflects badly on your lord. Keep that in mind if you serve someone
My pegasus has a refined palate and kicks away any food that's not up to par. It's bad behavior.
I used to serve a noble. But a terrible incident led to his downfall. Very regrettable…
Being hungry can make ya sad. You ever need food, you let me know.
Anatolia's always so hard on me. You think it's her way of flirting with me?
Back in the village, we hunted and ate sandworms. I'll bring you some sometime!
I can tell you're interested in me. I'm a good-lookin' guy, so I can't blame ya!
My parents are gone, but I don't really feel lonely. I'm stronger than anyone, ya know!
Nothing personal, but you don't really look that tasty. You're all bones for one thing. I'll save you for last.
I can tell how a building is put together with just a glance. What about you?
Everyone in the village is always hungry. I wanna make it so they can all eat whenever they want.
Know what? I like you. How about if you join the Dadao Gang? i'm strong, and I'll take care of you!
I will read you the masterpiece by my father Aeneus. It's powerful enough to move even your avian heart!
In moments of reflection, a demon taunts me, telling me I have no talent. Have you heard its voice too?
Ahh, how I adore the city. You can sit back and witness the bustle, the confusion — the ecstasy!
I grew up in a home surrounded by natural beauty, where I awoke each morning to birdsong.
I'm partial to birds' faces — not like fishes', with those soulless eyes. Mirrors reflecting nothing. Gah!
Intoxicants add color to one's experiences — bring out a new side to any conversation! Don't you agree?
Had I wings like yours, I could fly at once to any research subject I wanted. Imagine it!
It's too bad you don't speak any human languages. I'm sure you'd have tales to tell.
Through the temples, I've been given so many story ideas! In that way the temples are a generous patron.
My last work was a masterpiece — but my next will be even better. Yes! For I am always improving.
I don't need to sleep on a bed. I can rest anywhere. Is it the same for you?
I know how to preserve meat by applying an herbal rub and smoking it. Do you like fragrant food?
You have a strangely penetrating gaze. Your eyes would be an advantage in battle.
I've been all over, doing work as a messenger for a temple. But I've never seen a bird like you until now.
Poisonous plants will harm people, but they can be made into medicine. As always, knowledge is key.
My tattoos mark me as a member of the Har Hali clan. I left them years ago, but they're still part of me.
Orchel once saved my life. It's only natural that I want to return the favor, right?
I'm happy with my life now. There's no reason to worry about me.
Do you worship Balor? I used to long ago, but I don't these days.
You need agility to survive in forests. I wonder, are you agile when you're in trees?
I detest restraints. And you?
You show no signs of fear. That is unusual. You are unusual.
I cannot find a fitting opponent for a duel. I am parched. Not my throat, but my soul.
A sea beast diverted me to this land. Perhaps it was the hand of fate.
Still your mind. Let it be a secluded pond. Give yourself to silence. It is good to meditate.
I like your eyes. They are as bright as sunlight.
I dislike those who fetter me… They constrain joy and supply boredom.
You do not mind if I touch you?
I sense in you something profound and menacing. Perhaps Answerer can expose it.
I hate being looked down on. But I guess a refined lady can't wallop her foes… can she?
Sometimes the guys in Dagsion turn my head, but… No! Sweetie's the one for me!
I hope my mom's doing OK. If I could fly like you, I'd go see her.
If you're hungry, come find me! I'll slip you some tasty fish!
My mom and dad always said I have pretty eyes. What do you think?
What I hate most are liars. It's not good to deceive people and then laugh about it to yourself.
You know, you don't smell like other birds. Hold still. Let me check!
When I'm all by myself fishing, I like to sing. Just me, the waves, the wind, and my voice.
My dad taught me everything I know about the sea. I wonder it I'm shaping up to be like him.
All the nobles like to throw flashy parties, or so I hear. What's so great about parties?
In this land, the sun's rays are relentless. I wish for something to block them.
How beautiful you are. A fine specimen for my scalpel, hmm?
The plants of Dagda are of much interest to me. I would observe and sketch many more
You are the best kind of beast — no foolish words or wasted actions.
I have spent some time with this guise by now. I have, hmm, acclimated to it.
Is this land strange, or have I become strange? I find I cannot say.
What, then, is the purpose of celebrating the day of one's birth? It escapes me.
Simply catching sight of a thing of beauty is enough to lift the spirits.
I am ill-suited to physical labor. Those who are should be the ones to do it. Obvious, isn't it?
I have feigned the role of a missionary for years, yet these simple beasts do not question it. Amazing.
Sometimes when I read poetry, I swear it's almost like I'm listening to music.
If you're ever hurt, come find me, and I'll heal you.
Your eyes are so kind. They make me feel safe…
Maybe the reason I'm drawn to you is because, like that person, you're hard to grasp…
Romance has always been a bit tough for me to grasp. Maybe a friend like you is all I need.
War and pain, fighting and hate… All of it just makes me sad… I'd like to avoid those things if I can.
Oh… I'm sorry… I suddenly feel like crying…
There are times when I can't take my mind off of the one I adore… That's normal, right?
Um… Doesn't being with me… bore you?
Love is a strange thing… Have you ever had feelings for someone?
Ugh, busywork makes me so mad! Is there some way for me to feel better?
Hey, if some bully ever comes at you, you talk to me. I'll twist 'em in knots!
My head's spinning... When people talk about stuff that's complicated, I get dizzy.
They say I got giant's blood. Bwahaha. It's funny!
No matter how hard he gets knocked down, my brother keeps gettin' up. He's got spirit, that guy!
I never forget to train. If your body's in shape, there's nothing you can't do!
People like having me around in battles, but other than that, usually not.
Don't sit on my hand. I'm worried I might squish you.
The chief of my old tribe was a jerk. If you ever see him, let me know, and I'll knock him out.
I like your determined look. Hey, you know you can count on the Unkillable Guzran, right?
Are you living your life to the fullest? If not, why bother being alive at all!
I earned my nickname, Unkillable Guzran, one scar at a time. Pretty cool, right?
There are only so many meals we can eat in our lifetimes. Best to eat what you want, yeah?
I'm one of the most seasoned mercenaries here! Do I have the look of a battle survivor?
The truth is — my true form is that of a bird. So I wonder, are you really a person?
All this peace and quiet is making me sleepy. How about you do something to wake me up?
Lots of people got to where they are today because of me. One merc is now imperial inspector!
Ha! A lady socked me real hard a little earlier. That just means she was shy, yeah?
My advice — make certain you're the one to make the calls in battle. Otherwise, it's a sure way to die.
I bought a cute accessory case the other day! But it was cheap, and it broke the next day.
I can't fight as well as everybody else, but I can maybe be useful in other ways, right?
I like making sweets. Maybe I could make something sweet for you sometime.
I'm good at crafts. I ought to try making something with bird feathers, maybe.
Nasshim used to take care of me. He was so nice. I still think about him sometimes...
I saw a magician make a bird appear in their hand from nowhere! I want to try it. Can you shrink?
I've been thinking about my next performance, and I think people would love it if we did a trick together.
When I think about the future, I always end up worrying about stuff I can't do anything about.
I think taste is more important than looks when it comes to vegetables, don't you?
It doesn't matter how long I'm gone, thinking of my family and my hometown makes me feel so lonely.
I lose all track of time when I'm practicing with my bow. So if you see me at night, give a holler!
When I'm fighting, I'll say some horrifying things. Like I did when I possessed those awful remains.
It's nice having family and friends to help when you're in trouble. Always treasure your friends, OK?
I used to hunt birds with my bow. Ha! Want to see if you can outfly one of my arrows?
I don't leave much of an impression on people. But you're so beautiful I bet you do…
I wonder how I would have fared in the Heroic Games if I didn't have Ugo's bow…
I'm not very skilled at dealing with men. Could you help me out if one harasses me?
Everyone back at my village speaks in a very unique way. Do birds have accents or dialects?
Do you know the Order of Mithras? I'd suggest that you steer clear of them.
I'm a bit tired. Forgive me if I fall asleep.
What would you do if I said there's a venomous spider behind you? Let's practice. Drive it off… now!
You bring a sort of calm atmosphere to a place. Mind if I linger here a little longer?
Do you think it wrong to accept payment from a lord you're drawn to serve?
I'm not all that ill-tempered, really. I wonder if you'd like to be more sociable too.
Do you think we need someone to lead us? I believe in such an ideal, and I welcome your thoughts on it.
Ha, you have an interesting face. I never get tired of seeing it.
My beloved steed, Rocinan, is aging very well. Do you think that when you see him?
I end up saying too much when talk turns to lords and their duties. Should I say less about it all?
It's natural to help one's friends and also the weak. But it sometimes takes courage to do what's right.
I've traveled all over the land. Have you visited lots of places too?
When you do nothing but battle, you can end up feeling pretty frazzled…
I have things I want to protect. Is there something that you want to protect?
Sometimes you've got to get sneaky if you want to survive. I mean, when you really have to!
What's it like if you get hit by heavy rain while you're flying?
When you love your family and it all falls apart, that's about as bad as it gets, right?
If someone settles down somewhere, a big home is best to house a big family, right?
I had a husband, you know. He died some time ago, but I wonder if he watches over me.
I don't value money over other things. But aren't there things you can't protect without money?
You always seem to be alone. Don't you get lonely out there in the world, all by yourself?
I can't arouse suspicion. Will I look more like a clown if you're perched on my wrist?
Ahh, I'm feeling great since I got to let my freak loose! How 'bout you?
Made this costume myself. Pretty good uniform for the Infernal Clown, don't ya think?
Makeup's great. It hides your blood, your tears… your crimes. You wanna get made up?
Guuh. Too many nasty stories. I'm gonna sleep — keep an eye out.
Guh, there's nothing I hate more than people who act high and mighty. I wanna yank out their guts!
Lookin' for a new look? How about a little birdie-blood dye job? Heh heh heh!
Bertrand's so serious! The guy hardly ever takes a joke. Y'know how hard that is for me?
Birds, you're so lucky. In a flash, you can fly out to murder scenes! Heh heh heh!
I'm tired — almost like I'm sick. I'm at such a low point… I can't take it!
I've been praying a lot ever since I've been seeing ghosts of those I killed. You pray too if you see 'em.
My old crew used to love me. I hope they're doing alright. You think they'll join up with me again?
You should join my Black-Swan Pirates. I tell you, there's nothing more fun than life as a pirate!
The Order of Mithras is rotten to the core. They're far more dangerous than pirates.
That fool sank my ship, but I still see it sailing right and fine in my dreams. A beautiful vessel!
I'm the Rukh, and you're a little bird. So you'll help a friend out if I'm chased down, right?
What would you do if you saw a ghost? Truth be told, I just faint dead away. Pathetic, I know…
When I get my crew together, I swear I'll do no harm, only look for treasure. Would you come with me?
You know a royal jerk who goes by Talimun? Peck out his eyes if you see him, alright?
They say I'm successor to the legendary pirate Drake. His hideout was all mine. Incredible, right?
The key to dancing is good posture. Slouch, and you'll only give a pitiful performance.
I often wonder if there's any point in praying to the gods.
I'm willing to use any means – make any sacrifice – to achieve my goal. Is that wrong?
In the middle of playing, I often find I'm returning to songs from back home. I guess I'm nostalgic
Birds are good at singing, aren't they? So how about I play my vihuela and you sing for me?
I can't stand snakes. If there was a snake here, you would chase it away, right?
I've been having trouble sleeping. I wonder if hearing a lullaby would help?
It's nice being showered in applause. If you want to experience it, come fly to me when I'm performing.
The next time I make food, will you try it? Humans don't seem to like my cooking, but maybe a bird…
If you see me on a horse ride, you'd better swoop down and say hello.
Next time I go hunting, I'll bring back some for you.
Urgh… I wish the day would come that my whole family could live together like we used to.
When I've been working nonstop, sometimes a breather does me a world of good.
Working for someone who doesn't trust you isn't too bad. The money's nice, at least.
I'll have to be careful not to shoot you by mistake when I go hunting.
Do you like sparkly things? Wanna see my gems?
Would it be coldhearted of me to say that money's more important to me than trust?
When I think about what I'll do with all this money I've saved… that's gonna be a great day.
I like counting my savings over and over. Makes me feel like I'm getting closer to my dream.
Birds eat fish, right? I'll catch a big one for you sometime!
I don't know who my parents are, but I don't really care. Things are good now. That's what matters
There's a horrible guy who I know from my temple. I'm going to punch him if he treats me badly again.
I stole things before I worked for the temple. I'd get punished if caught and still have a scar. Wanna see?
Even if it gets kinda boring, I can't complain if I've got a place to sleep and enough to eat.
You live in the forest, right? So tell me… how do you feel about ghosts?
It's better to learn how to use a blade than sit around in a classroom learning stuff. I'm right… right?
I love sweets. How about I bring you my favorites sometime?
Ozin taught me how to defend myself. Now I want to be strong enough, so he doesn't have to worry!
I'm pretty happy with my life now. But my heart goes out to my ol' street-orphan friends…
Dante's work is amazing! Here, let me read you something!
Father always said I was a fantastic swordsman. Couldn't ever impress him with axes, though…
I've been working so hard at the company. Whew! I think I need a vacation.
You know, I do a little bit of writing myself. I should write something with you as the main character.
I saw this couple the other day, and they had so much passion! Kinda made me jealous
If I had wings? I'd travel the world and see everything this life has to offer.
Ugh! Gummy, sticky, greasy… I just hate dirty things.
One day, I'd love to be the main character of some grand adventure. Would you want to come with me?
Ugggh. Turns out, the person I like already has a partner… How will I ever recover…
You're pretty smart for a bird. Are you one of those spirits in disguise like in the stores?!
Am I too serious? Sometimes people react to me as if I was nagging them.
I sometimes find my own inexperience frustrating...
Turning down the advances of passionate women wears on me, mentally and physically...
I must strive to surpass my father, so I can stand shoulder to shoulder with the brave veterans!
I like gazing at the sky. There's nothing silly about that... right?
I'm considering if I should force myself to visit home. My stepfather and I don't get along very well.
Being with you puts me at such ease that I wish I could cage you to take you wherever I go.
To look at you gives me the same feeling as when I gaze up at the sky
I bet it would feel incredible to fly alongside you in the clouds.
Despite the complaints, I have every right to refuse a night's drinking. I don't tolerate alcohol well.
None of these grunts around here have a chance of beating me. Why do they even try?
Doesn't matter who comes at me — they're no match for the great Majide, right?
Everyone knows the great Majide has the strength of 10 men. How about I smash some rocks for you?
I shoved a mouthy drunk real hard. Felt pretty good, I gotta admit. But now it's time I catch some z's.
Nothin' better than smacking around nobodies when I'm annoyed. What do you do when you are?
If my Southern Cross Brigade crew had battled in the games, we would have won, right?
You're not scared of me, whcih means you don't get how great I am. How about I show you?
That damned Order of Mithras left me for dead. They can't abandon the great Majide!
I'm bored as hell. Got a good move to show me?
Prison cells are my home away from home. Next time I'm locked up, find me and we'll play a game!
Just because a mom's marriage failed doesn't mean her daughter will make the same mistake. Right?
I'm not the best singer. I enjoy it, but I can't carry a tune.
Say there's a guy in the tavern causing a fuss and I need to punch him out. Should I avoid the face?
My sister taught me how to cook. She's incredible. One taste and your heart just soars.
I wonder how much strength is in that body. Maybe I should just give you a little squeeze.
Owing debts is no good. As long as they're hanging over you, you can't think straight.
Money is the root of hardship. Not that you need to worry about that!
Be careful out there. If you see someone suspicious, just fly off, quick as you can!
It's good to get strong. That way you're ready when it's time to kick out your good-for-nothing husband!
Do you have someone dear to you? I hope so. Do whatever you can to protect them.
Sirocco's so great — I just really wish he didn't spend all his time womanizing.
I don't know where my dad is now. Hope he's eating and stuff
Back when Mom still lived at home, she'd train me! Wanna give that a shot?
Everyone treats me like a kid. I wonder if that'll ever change
You have kind eyes. Looking at them really makes me feel better.
My mom loves singing, and she's AWFUL at it. You seem like a good singer, though, right?
I'm pretty knowledgeable about medicinal herbs. If you ever get injured, I'll fix you up!
Wanna try my cooking sometime? No one else will eat it.
I want to help people when they're in trouble. But I gotta get way stronger to do that!
I didn't think I had much in common with my mom, but maybe she's where I got my pushiness.
You've got weird eyes. Ya know, they kinda remind me of Anatolia's.
We ate what we could get in the village. Even bugs. Back there, you woulda been a delicacy.
If you see someone in trouble, you should help them. It's that simple!
The people of the village were real nice to me, so I wanna try and make them happy
Martial arts tightens my mind and strengthens my body. You should give it a try too!
Everybody's always yelling at me to be quiet. Am I really that loud?
Maybe I got a little too into my training? I'm sleepy now.
Everybody treats me like a kid just 'cause I'm short. It's no good to judge folks on appearances, ya know?
Looking at the clouds always is a balm for my hurt and heart. Would you join me, looking?
When I look at someone, they in turn look away. It seems that I'm forever feared.
I like being alone in my solitude. Do you too?
The spirits want to talk to you. They're… curious about you.
Yes, truly… It is wonderful fun, isn't it… What, can't you see who I'm speaking with?
I have a strong dislike for insects. Could you chase off any who draw too close to me?
I fear that my words enter the ear in strange ways. I am misunderstood… and avoided.
Death haunts me. Are you haunted by death?
I would be grateful if you would pray with me, that wayward souls may move on to the next world.
City life is still strange to a forest-dweller like me. If I get lost in Dagsion, would you show me the way?
Birds have many meals each day, yes? I hope you eat well and fly vigorously
We of the Har Hali live in harmony with nature. You are not the first bird I would befriend.
Hm. These disheveled feathers must make it hard to fly. I'll straighten them for you.
I suspect no one could tarnish your wings. Keep true to your way of life. Let no one take you captive.
My skills did not live up to those of previous chiefs. Have I been of use to my people at all?
A mere graze from our poison arrows can fell a bird instantly. Stay well away during our hunts.
My people use the behavior of animals as an omen for battle. A bold attitude is a good omen.
Rule based on strength only chokes the people. I'm sure you would also feel suffocated under oppression.
We must not isolate ourselves out of pride. That way is death. Do not forget this.
Merceries are more selective about work than you'd think. People don't understand that.
You have to learn a little bit about everything to grow. What can I learn from your movements?
I studied hard to learn how to read and write. Do you think you could do that too?
After I left my kingdom, I broke one of its laws by learning to write. Yu Phas will surely punish me.
Don't worry. I have no interest in hunting you. I don't even like meat.
People rely on me a lot, but I have to admit it'd be nice if I could rely on others more.
I like eating sweet things. That surprises people. But is that really so unexpected?
I left my kingdom behind, but there are still many in Saramis who look up to me. I'm grateful.
What must motherhood be like? I can't help but find the prospect terrifying.
I will best Leilidahna one day, I swear it. And I hope you'll cheer me on!
Kalla is so lovely! I imagine you'd fall in love with her at first sight.
Shall I compose a poem about you? If so, I'll do all I can to make sure it pleases you…
Listening to music played by another, I can sometimes feel their emotions. Do you share this?
In either music or dance, one missed day of practice costs you some skill. Never neglect your studies!
I was recognized as the Blue Rose of Caelus. Would you like to hear me play?
Flowering trees bloom even as they get old. It proves that age should not impede one's pursuits! Agreed?
I have the greatest confidence in my singing. And yourself?
Oh dear, my handicraft turned out poorly again. I understand not why my artistic talent is failing me.
More of the people here grow to love us by the day. Is this the effect kings have on others?
We find ourselves bored at the moment. Can you perform any tricks?
We have enjoyed seafood since our earliest days and would like to savor Dagdan specialties with you.
We are from Brigid, which is a kingdom that loves nature. So we enjoy our time with you.
We deem you worthy of our protection, so if you're ever in trouble, please let us handle it
You must visit our kingdom. We would feed and entertain you magnificently!
We are very fond of the people of Brigid. So if you see any, please tell us, alright?
You remind us of the spirits of our homeland. Perhaps we are connected somehow.
To learn the ways of a foreign land, there's no better way than to mingle with its people, right?
It's nice to walk around the forest and listen to all the sounds the animals make, huh?
What should I do when I get so scared my legs start shaking and I can't move?
I had a dream about a beautiful bird… I wonder if it was a friend of yours.
I look at you and... You make me feel like I can face even the most difficult things in life.
Everyone's fighting. It's scary, but I'm doing my best!
There's a ginji tree not far from here. We should go together and pick some of the fruit!
I like clouds. They're so big, and it's neat to see all the shapes they can take.
Taking it easy makes me sleepy… Hey, if I fall asleep, will you wake me up?
Some animals make all kinds of racket. But you don't do that, do you?
I just don't know what to do about these feelings I have for Tialla.
I enjoy writing fables. Are there any tales shared among birds? I'd love to hear them.
Care to join me fishing? It's nice to spend time idly, casting a fishing line.
I like lending a hand to those already trying to help themselves. Does that make me a meddler?
Do you detect anything... strange about how I look? I don't want to stand out.
People tell me I have a stern look much of the time. Do I really seem so harsh?
entries.note: The source article leaves this answer blank.

entries.topic: My daughter is currently in a long slumber. I hope to be at her side by the time she awakens.
Despite appearances, I carry more concerns than most people. Could I rest at your side awhile?
The land of Dagda is full of interesting things. It'd be fascinating to explore it with you.
